title: Wazir Khan Mosque
visualBrief: Individual medium-fi Wazir Khan Mosque: rose masonry ranges around an open paved court and green ablution pool, five pale ochre west prayer-hall domes, blue/cream/ochre tiled pointed central iwan, east gateway and four33 m octagonal minarets with balconies and open chhatris. Main outer and all three open roof holes follow current map controls. Small court pavilion retains its own mapped plan and3 m total. Six existing shared256² graphs serve seven merged roles. Original geometry and color fields, no copied photographs, tile artwork, inscriptions or furnished interiors.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Retained Q2352054 / relation8420214 anchor [74.323613747,31.5832002] and heading -0.022862258642 rad remain unchanged. Current named Wazir Khan Mosque POI confirms identity. Twelve current building/part controls retain 178 vertices: main34-vertex outer with21/4/4-vertex courtyard/lightwell holes, small court pavilion, four octagonal minarets, five west prayer-hall domes and the east gate dome. Positive X faces east toward the entry and Chowk Wazir Khan; the prayer hall is west at negative X. Positive Z faces south. Separate shrines, city houses and the plaza remain host content.
